reader_summary.overview: An acquisition so wild and crazy, they had to do it again. Ben & David cover tech’s perhaps most-traded asset, Skype (which also happens to be a fantastic business). How do we even know which deal to grade? Tune in to find out… Sponsors: Legora: Vanta: ServiceNow: Statsig: More Acquired!
